name: College Roommate Simulator
source:
Murphy likes drawing guys in his sketchbook, getting stoned and watching stupid videos on the internet, and has never had sex before.

Kyle loves getting drunk and talking about hot girls, has a thing for sleeping naked, and jerks off whenever he feels like it. 

And now Kyle and Murphy are roommates.

In this 20,000 word 3D visual novel, you play as Murphy as he starts his freshman year of college, living with a guy he secretly fantasizes about. Make choices that determine whether the two will be friends, fuck buddies or something more. This game contains three endings and three different sex scenes, as well as multiple scenes exploring the ins and outs of living with another guy.

Grab your tissues and lotion and put a sock on the door handle. This is College Roommate Simulator.

[From [url=https://wannabeyourdog2.itch.io/college-roommate-simulator]Itch.io[/url]]
